{"rules": ["Model exhibits severe upward bias when recent history shows consolidation around 87-89 EUR despite near-zero sentiment.", "Forecast fails to capture immediate volatility; true outcomes show sharp drops (e.g., -2.5 EUR in first week) while model predicts steady linear growth.", "Systematic overshoot occurs after initial price spikes: model projects continued ascent, but true outcome reverses direction within 10 days.", "Mean reversion is underestimated: when price deviates >3% from recent average (87-89), model fails to correct trajectory toward historical mean.", "Sentiment history of zero provides no predictive signal for short-term corrections; rely on price momentum reversal instead."]
